Due to chondromalacia I had to stop doing all leg work for a year.

Now I'm back in the gym doing 5x5. I bench in the mid 150 range but my squats are like 100. Should I just keep benching, rowing, and pressing the same weight until my legs catch up, or should I do extra leg work?
Imbalance between legs/upper body: What to do?
You could bike on non lifting days to catch up.

Bottom line is you are going to need extra leg work to catch up. Try working in an extra workout or two a week. GVT is one of the best ways to gain size/strength quickly. It's brutal, especially with legs, but results are impressive.

You don't need to do anything special, just go back to doing legs like you did before and they'll catch up quick enough. If anything, doing "extra" leg work will only cause you to become overtrained and set you back further, especially on a 5x5 program.
